summary.text: Eddie Lee Murphy of Spring Hill, an independent who qualified by petition, filing on February 17, 2026, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Tennessee to Marsha Blackburn, with 0.1% of the vote to her 45.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He was one of eight Republican candidates in the October 7, 2025, special-election contest for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District. No campaign website, platform or occupation could be found.
